title: This is an amazing app
body: I want to acknowledge the effort and attention to detail that went into creating this app. The detailed report of my streaks, including monthly and yearly views, has been very useful. I would also like to express my gratitude for the motivating quotes provided. I highly recommend this app to individuals with a questioner personality type and anyone who wants to track their habits using streaks. Once again, thank you for the excellent work.
author: Nnenna_Nnenna
